HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.label: Yamato Shogunate
HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.description: Descendants of the colony ship Takamagahara, the clans of Yamato rebuilt the old order of their islands: an emperor who reigns in silence, a shogun who rules in his name and warrior houses bound by duty. They value craft above wealth and patience above speed, and their swordsmiths are the finest in the world.

doctrine.label: bushido
doctrine.description: Samurai attack in small bands from several sides at once and pick their targets with care. Calm in the face of death, they fight on through wounds.
